general.llamamiento_sin_expediente: Open the case from the request list to make its call-up.
general.llamamiento_seleccion: Call the next person on the job pool
general.llamamiento_comunicacion: Record the notice to the person
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_seleccion: You are about to call the next person on the job pool for this case, in job pool order. If you already did it, you will see the same call-up: no new one is created.
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_comunicacion: You are about to record that you notified the person called. VEC does not send the email or check that it arrived.
general.llamamiento_prueba_ayuda: The notice details come from the call-up: you do not need to type them.
general.llamamiento_espera_seleccion: First call the next person on the job pool.
general.llamamiento_error: We could not confirm whether it was saved. Press “Try again”: it will not be duplicated. If it keeps happening, tell IT.
general.llamamiento_validacion: Some details are missing or not valid. Check the form and try again.
general.llamamiento_preparacion_error: The request could not be prepared. Reload the page and try again; if it keeps happening, tell IT.
general.llamamiento_rechazada: It was not saved. Check the details and try again.
general.llamamiento_conflicto: It could not be saved because the case has changed. Do not repeat it; tell IT.
general.llamamiento_contenido_respuesta_en_confl: Another reply is already recorded for this call-up. Open the case and check it before continuing.
general.llamamiento_consulta_sin_contexto: The reply cannot be checked yet.
general.llamamiento_consulta_cargando: Checking whether a reply is already recorded…
general.llamamiento_consulta_ausente: No reply has been recorded yet.
general.llamamiento_consulta_ausente_sin_anteced: No reply has been recorded and it cannot be recorded from here. If you think this is wrong, tell IT.
general.llamamiento_consulta_registrada_sin_reci: A reply is already recorded, but its receipt cannot be shown.
general.llamamiento_consulta_sin_respuesta_verif: No reply has been recorded yet. If you have it, record it below.
general.llamamiento_consulta_intento_no_confirma: A reply was sent but could not be confirmed. Do not record another one; tell IT.
general.llamamiento_consulta_denegado: You do not have permission to see this reply. If you need it, ask your manager.
general.llamamiento_consulta_error: We could not check whether there is a reply. Press “Check again”; if it keeps happening, tell IT.
general.llamamiento_comunicaciones_sin_contexto: Open a case to see its call-ups.
general.llamamiento_comunicaciones_lista: Choose the call-up you want to continue with.
general.llamamiento_comunicaciones_vacia: This case has no call-ups yet.
general.llamamiento_comunicaciones_denegado: You do not have permission to see these call-ups.
general.llamamiento_comunicaciones_error: The call-ups could not be loaded. Press “Load again”; if it keeps happening, tell IT.
general.llamamiento_comunicaciones_revisar_tras_: The reply could not be confirmed. Load the list again before continuing.
general.llamamiento_comunicaciones_intento_no_co: Do not record another reply until IT checks the previous one.
general.llamamiento_respuesta_resultado_incierto: We could not confirm whether it was saved. Press “Try again” with the same details: it will not be duplicated.
general.llamamiento_recibo_seleccion_ayuda: Person called. The receipt does not show their details.
general.llamamiento_recibo_comunicacion_ayuda: Notice recorded. VEC does not send the email.
general.llamamiento_respuesta: Record the reply from the person called
general.llamamiento_opcion_aceptacion_despues: You can then prepare the appointment proposal.
general.llamamiento_opcion_renuncia_despues: You can then call the next person on the job pool.
general.llamamiento_respuesta_ayuda: Record the reply that arrived by email. The email stays in your mailbox.
general.llamamiento_recibida_en: Date and time the reply arrived
general.llamamiento_correo_calculado: Email checked. Review the details and press “Record reply”.
general.llamamiento_correo_error: The email could not be read. Choose an .eml file of up to 2 MB. If it keeps happening, tell IT.
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_respuesta: You are about to record this reply: {respuesta}. Email “{correo}”, received on {recibida}. Check the reply and the email before confirming.
general.llamamiento_respuesta_validacion: Choose the reply, type the email reference and the date and time it arrived, and attach the email (.eml).
general.llamamiento_respuesta_hora_no_univoca: That time does not exist or is repeated because of the clock change. Tell IT so they can record it.
general.llamamiento_recibo_respuesta_ayuda: Reply recorded. The email stays in your mailbox.
general.llamamiento_resultado_sucesor_renuncia_p: They declined. Another person will need to be called, but this cannot be done from this screen yet.
general.llamamiento_resultado_declaracion_no_dis: No reply has been recorded yet.
general.llamamiento_resultado_circuito_pendiente: Waiting for HR to check and confirm the reply.
general.llamamiento_resultado_vencimiento_no_eva: No deadline yet: it starts when you record the contact with the person.
general.llamamiento_resultado_siguiente_resoluci: Check the reply and confirm it.
general.llamamiento_resultado_siguiente_continua: Call the next person on the job pool.
general.llamamiento_resultado_siguiente_aviso: Record the notice to the next person.
general.llamamiento_resultado_siguiente_propuest: Proposal saved. Refresh the case to see what comes next.
general.llamamiento_resultado_limite: Recording the reply does not confirm it: HR confirms it afterwards.
general.llamamiento_revision_respuesta_rrhh: I have checked the reply and the email
general.llamamiento_revision_plazo_rrhh: I have checked the reply deadline
general.llamamiento_validacion_manual_desarrollo: HR does the check by hand.
general.llamamiento_resolucion_ayuda: Check the recorded reply and its email before confirming it.
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_resolucion: You are about to confirm this reply: {respuesta}. Check the reply and the email before confirming.
general.llamamiento_validacion_respuesta_pendien: The HR check is missing. Tick both boxes and try again.
general.llamamiento_recibo_resolucion_ayuda: Reply confirmed in the case and in the job pool.
general.llamamiento_intencion_siguiente_ayuda: The next person has not been called yet.
general.llamamiento_siguiente: Call the next person on the job pool
general.llamamiento_siguiente_pendiente: Waiting to call the next person
general.llamamiento_siguiente_ayuda: After a withdrawal or no reply, call the next person on the job pool.
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_siguiente: You are about to call the next person on the job pool, in order. If you already did it, you will see the same call-up: no new one is created.
general.llamamiento_siguiente_validacion: The next person cannot be called yet. Refresh the case; if it keeps happening, tell IT.
general.llamamiento_recibo_siguiente_ayuda: Next person called. The notice still has to be recorded.
general.llamamiento_comunicacion_siguiente: Record the notice to the next person
general.llamamiento_comunicacion_siguiente_ayuda: Record that you notified the next person. VEC does not send the email.
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_comunicacion_si: You are about to record that you notified the next person. VEC does not send the email or check that it arrived.
general.llamamiento_comunicacion_siguiente_valid: The notice cannot be recorded yet. Refresh the case; if it keeps happening, tell IT.
general.llamamiento_comunicacion_siguiente_recib: Notice to the next person recorded
general.llamamiento_recibo_comunicacion_siguient: Notice recorded. VEC does not send the email.
general.llamamiento_respuesta_siguiente: Record the reply from the next person
general.llamamiento_respuesta_siguiente_ayuda: Record the reply from the next person. The email stays in your mailbox.
general.llamamiento_respuesta_siguiente_validaci: Choose the reply, type the email reference and the date and time it arrived, and attach the email (.eml).
general.llamamiento_respuesta_siguiente_recibo: Reply from the next person recorded
general.llamamiento_recibo_respuesta_siguiente_a: Reply recorded. HR still has to confirm it.
general.llamamiento_resolucion_siguiente: Check and confirm the reply from the next person
general.llamamiento_resolucion_siguiente_ayuda: Check the recorded reply and its email before confirming it.
general.llamamiento_resolucion_siguiente_recibo_: Acceptance from the next person confirmed
Declining from the next person confirmed
general.llamamiento_recibo_resolucion_siguiente_: Reply confirmed in the case and in the job pool.
general.llamamiento_intencion_siguiente_historic: When the withdrawal was recorded, the next person was still waiting to be called.
general.llamamiento_propuesta_pantalla_ayuda: Confirmed acceptance permits the proposal to be reviewed and recorded using the following action.
general.llamamiento_propuesta_pantalla_anteceden: What has been done so far
general.llamamiento_propuesta_pantalla_limite: This proposal remains a draft. It does not send documents or appoint the candidate.
general.llamamiento_propuesta_ayuda: With the acceptance confirmed, save the appointment proposal. It is an unsigned draft.
general.llamamiento_propuesta_no_disponible: The proposal documents could not be loaded. Press “Load again”; if it keeps happening, tell IT.
general.llamamiento_propuesta_pendiente: Documents loaded. Review and save the proposal.
general.llamamiento_propuesta_validacion: The proposal cannot be prepared yet. Refresh the case; if it keeps happening, tell IT.
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_propuesta: You are about to save the appointment proposal for this case. It is a draft: nobody is signed off or appointed yet.
general.llamamiento_propuesta_actualizacion_pend: Proposal saved, but the case has not been refreshed. Do not repeat it; press “See updated case”.
general.llamamiento_recibo_propuesta_ayuda: Proposal saved as an unsigned draft.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_ayuda: Manual validation is not a legal signature, does not produce administrative effect and does not evidence document custody.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_revision: I have expressly reviewed the proposal and resolution document.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_limites: Official signature: no. Administrative effect: no. Document custody: no.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_validacion: Check the number, date, reason and both confirmations.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_cancelada: Action cancelled; you may correct the details.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_recuperacion_ca: Retrieval cancelled; the uncertain request remains unchanged.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_rechazada: You may correct the details and submit again.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_incierta: Uncertain outcome: keep the details and retry to retrieve the receipt.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_conflicto_consu: There is a conflict. Checking the case record; the request and its key remain unchanged.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_conflicto_histo: Historic receipt retrieved from the case. This does not confirm that it matches the conflicting request; no further resolution has been submitted.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_conflicto_sin_r: The query returns no receipt. The key may already have been used: the details remain locked and you may only retry the exact request.
general.resolucion_formalizacion_conflicto_lectu: The case receipt could not be verified. The uncertain request and its key are retained; you may only retry without changing the details.
general.llamamiento_contacto_validacion: Type the date and time of the contact and the reference of how it is recorded.
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_contacto: You are about to record the contact on {instante} ({prueba}). The reply deadline starts from that moment.
general.llamamiento_prueba_ref: Reference of how the contact is recorded
general.llamamiento_plazo_no_admitida: Response received after the deadline: the rule does not allow it
general.llamamiento_causa_validacion: Type the date and the reference of the document that justifies the reason.
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_causa: You are about to record the justified reason with document {prueba}.
general.llamamiento_propuesta_expiracion: The person has not replied within the deadline. If you confirm it, the call-up is treated as not accepted and you can call the next person.
general.llamamiento_confirmacion_expiracion: You are about to treat the call-up as not accepted because there was no reply. You can then call the next person.
general.llamamiento_revision_respuesta_rrhh_expi: I have checked that no reply has arrived
general.llamamiento_revision_plazo_rrhh_expiraci: I have checked that the deadline has ended
